ModMetaData.name: Battle Survivors (Dynamic Diplomacy x Eternal Pawns)
ModMetaData.author: Ghost
ModMetaData.description:
Dynamic Diplomacy destroys every pawn left on a battle map once the battle is decided and the player is not there. Eternal Pawns only saves a pawn when it is passed to world pawns, so surviving winners were lost.
Right before Dynamic Diplomacy destroys a living pawn, this mod hands it to Eternal Pawns if it is a saved veteran or was pinned with "Remember". Veterans still fight in battles as before, and the survivors return to the pool.
A downed remembered pawn left behind by the losing side is treated as a captive: 50% it is recruited by the winning faction (and joins its veteran pool), 50% it is killed.
Does nothing if Dynamic Diplomacy or Eternal Pawns is not loaded. Needs no load order.
